title_sq: Cmim Kleringu! Tek Bulevardi I Ri, Shitet Apartament 3+1+Verande, Me Planimetri Dhe Orientim Perfekt!
description_sq: Cmim Kleringu! Tek Bulevardi Ri, Shitet Apartament 3+1+ Post Parkimi, Me Planimetri Dhe Orientim Perfekt! title_en: Price Clearing! At New Boulevard, Apartment 3+1+Veranda for sale, with perfect layout and orientation!
description_en: Price Clearing! At Ri Bulevardi, 3+1+ Parking Post Apartment For Sale, With Perfect Layout And Orientation! The property is located on the 9th residential floor and has a gross area of ​​135.69 m2 apartment and 65.7 m2 veranda. The orientation of the property is South-East, which makes it bright and sunny throughout the day. The area in which the apartment is located offers all the necessary facilities for a comfortable life. The apartment also has a parking space with an extra value of 16,000 euros.
